prompt: Here is an Eligius JSON config. Rewrite it as an Eligian project. The config is `source-config.json` in the current directory; the entry file of the project is `main.eligian` in the current directory. Keep the config's timelines (each timeline's name is its `uri`: `Hub`, `Chapter 1`, `Chapter 2` and `Timeline & Time`; the presentation starts on `Hub`), their durations, its action names, the operations of every action in their order, its controllers, the element ids of its `layoutTemplate` (that is the layout) and its locale strings; among those ids are `#stage`, `#hub`, `#hub-title`, `#card-1` to `#card-3` (the hub buttons), `#chapter-1` to `#chapter-3` (the views), `#back-1` to `#back-3` (the Back buttons), `#c3-title`, `#c3-intro`, `#c3-box`, `#c3-beat-2` and `#c3-beat-3`. The stylesheet that its `cssFiles` names is not supplied: write it, so that a `.view` is shown only while it carries the class `is-active` and a `.beat` only while it carries the class `is-visible`.
